hypotheses.root_cause: PCIe link training failed to reach L0 (LTSSM stuck in Polling/Recovery): Reference clock instability / gating during link training
hypotheses.rationale: Repeated LTSSM Recovery transitions with AER corrected errors followed by 'Link training timeout' point to physical-layer signal-integrity or refclk issues rather than software configuration. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'refclk instability', 'refclk' for RC_PCIE_REFCLK_GATING.
recommended_actions: Scope the refclk at the connector and SoC ball for gating/jitter
Disable spread-spectrum clocking and retest link training
Check refclk routing/spread-spectrum and PLL lock on the failing lane
Review SI margins and equalization (EQ) preset tuning for the negotiated gen

hypotheses.root_cause: Junction temperature exceeded the thermal trip threshold: Fan speed stays below the profile target as temperature rises
hypotheses.rationale: Temperature climbed past the DVFS policy and crossed the 105C trip point before throttling could recover it, triggering an emergency shutdown — a cooling-solution or fan-profile shortfall under sustained workload. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'fan speed below profile', 'target_rpm' for RC_FAN_PROFILE_BAD.
recommended_actions: Fix the fan curve / PWM mapping in the thermal policy
Verify tachometer feedback and fan power
Inspect heatsink mounting/TIM and airflow on the DUT
Make the fan/DVFS profile more aggressive ahead of the trip point
